protocol.candidate_schedule: all problem instances in ascending size/name order, round-robin

cold_load_plus_selection.definition: read and strictly deserialize the complete saved models artifact, retrieve the deployment full tree, then perform the hot selection path
cold_load_plus_selection.interpretation: model-object-cold diagnostic; not a storage-cache-cold measurement

hot_selection.definition: pre-execution feature mapping to model vector, memory-feasibility filter, candidate tree predictions, and deterministic argmin with an already loaded deployment model

protocol.percentile_method: linear interpolation at zero-based position (n - 1) * p

workload.comparison_denominator: minimum candidate median end-to-end wall time in the balanced dataset
